name: Teen CIT Camp (Counselor in Training)
what_you_do: Learn leadership skills while helping camp counselors and campers all summer. Each week you are paired with a lead counselor. Counselor training runs before camp.
who_can_apply: Teens ages 13 to 15 (must be 13 by June 1). The page lists no grade or school rule.
pay_detail: Teens pay. $50 registration, then $175 per week for YMCA members or $200 per week for non-members. The June 1 to 5 training week is free. No wages or stipend are listed.
duration: Up to 9 weeks (2026: June 8 to Aug 7), 7:30am to 5:30pm, plus free training June 1 to 5
deadline_text: 2026 registration opened Jan 12 and was first come, first served. 2027 dates not posted.
how_to_apply: Sign up online through the Y account system (Daxko) and pay the fee. Weekly sign up closes two weeks before each week. Money help is on the scholarship page. Contact youth@piedmontymca.org or 434-270-7534.
notes: A paid program for teens, not a job. It is a leadership step toward working as a camp counselor later. A Greene County CIT program is also listed on the Y site but was not read.
